OwnerPrincipal provenance: M16 says 'There is no creation operation on the kernel surface; the record is part of installing the kernel', State 3 says installation owns 'the installation record and its one owner principal', yet (a) no installation function touches the store, (b) start_kernel 'may append only seed, binding-drift and recovery records and never creates business facts', (c) `upsert_owner_principal` exists in the repository but is reachable from no function. Nobody inserts OwnerPrincipal; a fresh store has no owner and every owner-only operation refuses. Either start_kernel seeds it from protected config (installation_id -> principal_id, display_name) or an operator tool outside the 28 modules does.
'the installation record' (State 3, installation Owns) has no model in global_spec.models and no table.

A21 rule 4 lists 'suspending the owner principal' as an owner-only action, but no function in any module writes OwnerPrincipal.status (active <-> suspended); no OwnerDecisionRequest handler for it in these modules.
